source_text: — Ko‘p ichsa, u ham odamni aynitarmish.
target_text: But who was in front of him? His master!

target_text: His eshon! The great elder eshon!

target_text: No, he couldn’t raise his fist against him!

source_text: Eshon bu voqeani eshitgan edi; lekin unga o‘z muridi Razzoq so‘fining aralashganini bilmasidi.
target_text: After a moment, Razzoq-sufi melted like snow and his shame drove him quietly out the door.

source_text: So‘fi ko‘zlarida marvarid donalariday yirik-yirik yoshlar ko‘ringani holda, bilganicha aytib berdi.
target_text: He went home and lay down without uttering a word. He didn’t answer his wife’s questions.

source_text: Pir kulib turib (kulib turib!) eshitdi.
target_text: “Again, his mood has soured!” she thought.

source_text: Bu nash’alik kulish, bu kayfi chog‘lik, bu ovozdagi sho‘xlik hech nari-beri bo‘lmadi.
target_text: The poor thing still hadn’t heard about Zebi. The next morning over breakfast, he carefully told her everything that had happened.

source_text: So‘fi voqeaning eng qo‘rqunch joylarini aytib bergan vaqtida ham eshonning yuz-ko‘zlarida hamon o‘sha sho‘x va o‘ynoq kulish jilvalanardi.
target_text: The fist that he was about to bring down on the eshon’s head the previous night now came down on his own head.

source_text: «Men toshga gapirayotibman, shekilli», degan o‘yni o‘ylab oldi so‘fi: orqasidan darrov istig‘for aytdi... So‘zini bitirgach, So‘fi eshonning og‘ziga tikildi va «muborak» so‘zlariga muntazir bo‘lib qoldi.
target_text: And that fist was so powerful that Razzoq-sufi only had time to think: “Oh, if only yesterday I had …” By the time he went out on the street, having left his tea untouched, Razzoq-sufi no longer recognized himself.

source_text: Eshonning sho‘xligi yana orta tushgan edi.
target_text: He moved swiftly and unconsciously as if carried by the quick legs of Muslims in a funeral procession.

source_text: Xonaqo kuylarining eng sho‘xini olib, boshini to‘lg‘ay-to‘lg‘ay, butun vujudi bilan silkina-silkina kuyladi:
target_text: He closed and opened his fists. In a powerful wave, a scream forced its way to his throat, but it got stuck there.

source_text: Foniy dunyo be-esh kundir, be-esh kundir, ho-ov, So‘filik ahdi-in sindur, ahdin sindur, ho-ov.
target_text: Those who passed him on the street went without greetings, questions went without answers from him. Women cursed him as they passed.
